systems.owner: Prime Minister's Office, Government of National Unity
Minister of State for Digital Economy and Artificial Intelligence

note: Reports adoption of an AI ethics charter and a strategy, both non-binding instruments (class other); no binding rule on AI is stated.

systems.system: National Strategy for Artificial Intelligence in the State of Libya 2025-2030

note: Reports publication of a strategy (class other) that lists developing legislation as an aim; it names no law, decree or draft.
The minister only directed a team to prepare a draft regulation on AI tool use inside his ministry; no draft text exists in the story and it is not a national rule.

facts.fact: The Journal of the Academic Forum article abstract says Libya has a legislative vacuum on AI-related crimes and that Libyan legislation needs updating to cover them.

note: Says Libya is in the early stages of developing AI legislation and the forum recommends drafting an AI law; no draft or law stated.
